title: hieracium ucenicum subsp. arvasicum
intro: Hieracium ucenicum subsp. arvasicum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family with a long history of use in traditional medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium ucenicum subsp. arvasicum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
